note: Cursor models are selected via the UI (Cmd+L / Ctrl+L → model dropdown). This file provides squad recommendations. The Tech Lead should set the workspace default and communicate tier expectations to the team.

tier-s.rationale: Both have excellent code reasoning and large context. Claude 3.5 Sonnet is preferred for architecture; GPT-4o for implementation when code generation speed matters.

tier-a.rationale: Spec precision and validation require the same strength as design. Do not downgrade here — spec errors propagate.

tier-b.rationale: Discovery and domain modeling need good instruction following but less deep reasoning. 4o-mini is ~15x cheaper than 4o with adequate capability for these tasks.

tier-c.rationale: Lite agent and knowledge accumulation are high-volume, low-complexity. 4o-mini provides the best cost/throughput ratio.

ui_settings.agent_specific_switching: Cursor does not support per-agent model selection in rules. The human operator must manually switch models when delegating to tier-c agents to save cost, or accept the workspace default.
